name: massfinder
title: Diocese of Pittsburgh: Mass Finder map
command: pnpm diocese roster import pittsburgh massfinder scratch/map-pittsburgh/raw/massfinder-grouped.json
notes: Read 2026-10-23 from the rendered eCatholic finder (diopitt.org/massfinder, headed Chrome) with parish-site-access finder.py; 168 sites. group = the parish name before ' - ' in the site name. Lags on structure: still names St. Clare of Assisi Parish and St. Francis of Assisi Parish (now Saints Francis and Clare Parish per the parish list) and lists a handful of parish-level pins with no address (21737, 26316, 22384 'St. Padre Pio Parish', 22104, 23091 'Shrines of Pittsburgh', 33326) plus two non-church entries (38958 FEST Pittsburgh, 39162 Pittsburgh Central Deanery). Omits the 11 churches the parish pages list with no weekend Mass. Coordinates are the diocese's pins.
